keySetup.connectedAppHelp: Enable Use digital signatures in the existing Connected App OAuth settings and upload this public certificate. Configure administrator pre-authorization in its policies and authorize the target user through a profile or permission set.

generate.intro: Start here if you do not have the files needed for JWT. This flow creates a matching private key and public certificate on this computer.
steps: Choose a recognizable certificate name and a validity period.
Select Generate files. The tool creates server.key (private key) and server.crt (public certificate).
generate.note: This step makes no Salesforce changes. In the next step, upload only the public certificate to your Salesforce app.

export.intro: First export a keystore containing the private key from Salesforce, then return here to import it.
steps: Open Setup → Certificate and Key Management and locate the certificate.
Confirm Exportable Private Key was selected when creating the certificate. If the key cannot be exported, create a new certificate with this option selected.
Return to the certificate list, select Export to Keystore, set an export password, and save the .jks file.
export.note: Do not choose the .crt / .cer file from Download Certificate. It contains only the public certificate, which cannot be converted into or used to recover a private key.

configureAlibaba.intro: Configure the app and public certificate in Salesforce on Alibaba Cloud. Certificate preparation is the same; sign in using this org’s own My Domain login URL.
steps: Open Setup → App Manager / External Client App Manager, create or edit an External Client App, and enable OAuth.
Configure the required OAuth scopes, such as api, web, and refresh_token / offline_access for Salesforce CLI.
Enable JWT Bearer Flow. If the UI shows Use digital signatures, select that option. Upload this public certificate (server.crt) and save.
In app policies, select Admin approved users are pre-authorized and authorize the target user through a profile or permission set.
Copy the app Consumer Key for Client ID at sign-in. Obtain the login URL from Setup → My Domain.
configureAlibaba.note: Use this org’s My Domain login URL, not login.salesforce.com, test.salesforce.com, or a Lightning page URL. JWT needs no Consumer Secret; keep the private key locally.

configure.intro: Configure the app and public certificate in Salesforce. The private key stays on this computer.
steps: Open Setup → External Client App Manager, create an app or edit its settings, and enable OAuth. If creation requires a callback URL, use http://localhost:1717/OauthRedirect; JWT sign-in does not use this callback.
Select the OAuth scopes required for Salesforce CLI: api, web, and refresh_token / offline_access.
Under Flow Enablement, enable Enable JWT Bearer Flow, upload this public certificate (server.crt), and save.
Under Policies → OAuth Policies, set Permitted Users to Admin approved users are pre-authorized. Authorize the target user through a permission set or profile.
Under Settings → OAuth Settings → Consumer Key and Secret, copy the Consumer Key and enter it as Client ID at sign-in.
configure.note: Client ID means Consumer Key. JWT sign-in needs no Consumer Secret. Never upload the private key (server.key) to the app.

errors.opensslMissing: OpenSSL is not available. Follow the installation guidance and recheck.
errors.keytoolMissing: keytool is not available. Install a JDK and recheck.
errors.timeout: The local certificate tool timed out and this operation was stopped. Check the tool and try again.
errors.storage: Cannot write to this location. Choose a writable local folder.
errors.options: Use a certificate name of 1–64 characters without /, backslash, = or +, and a validity period of 1–3650 days.
errors.generate: Generation failed. Check OpenSSL and the storage location, then try again.
errors.publicOnly: This is a public certificate and contains no private key. Use Salesforce Export to Keystore, then import that keystore.
errors.keystoreInvalid: Choose a valid JKS / P12 / PFX keystore file, no larger than 32 MB.
errors.keystoreUnreadable: Cannot read this keystore. Choose the file again.
errors.read: Cannot read the keystore. Check its file and export password. If you just installed a JDK, recheck the local tools first.
errors.noPrivateKey: No entry contains a private key. Confirm that the Salesforce certificate allows private key export and export it again with Export to Keystore.
errors.alias: This entry is missing or has no private key. Read the certificate entries again.
errors.import: Extraction failed. Check the keystore password and any separate password for this private key.
errors.rsa: JWT needs an RSA private key. Select an entry with an RSA key.
errors.expired: This certificate has expired. Create or select a valid certificate and update the app certificate.
errors.mismatch: The key does not match the public certificate. Export the keystore for the same certificate again.
errors.export: Could not save the public certificate. Check the file and destination.
errors.exportPath: Save the public certificate as a .crt or .cer file. Do not overwrite a private key file.

loginErrors.defaultRestore: Could not restore the previous default org. Refresh the org list, check authorization status, and set the default org again.
loginErrors.busy: Another authorization is in progress. Wait for it to finish or cancel it.
loginErrors.usernameMismatch: The authorized username does not match this org. Check the username and try again.
loginErrors.credentials: Enter a valid Salesforce username and Client ID without spaces.
loginErrors.url: Enter an HTTPS login address without a path, query, or fragment. Use the My Domain login address.
loginErrors.keyUnreadable: Cannot read the private key. Choose an existing file using its absolute path.
loginErrors.keyInvalid: Choose an unencrypted PEM private key (.key / .pem), not a certificate or public key.
loginErrors.cliMissing: Salesforce CLI was not found. Install it and try again.
loginErrors.timeout: JWT authorization timed out after 120 seconds. Check your network and login address.
loginErrors.failed: JWT authorization failed. Check the username, Client ID, certificate, login address, and app access policies.
loginErrors.network: Salesforce CLI could not complete the request to the login address, so credentials could not be verified. Check the network, DNS, CLI HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY settings, and TLS trust, then retry once connectivity is restored.
loginErrors.notApproved: This user is not pre-authorized for the app. Ask an administrator to grant access through a permission set or profile.
loginErrors.scopeOrPreauth: The target org requires refresh_token / offline_access scope and an installed, pre-authorized app. Check the app OAuth scopes, administrator pre-authorization policy, and the target user’s profile or permission set access.
loginErrors.audience: The JWT audience does not match the login address. Check the environment and My Domain URL.
loginErrors.signature: JWT signature verification failed. Check that the private key matches the certificate uploaded to the app and that the certificate is valid.
loginErrors.client: The Client ID is invalid. Check the app Consumer Key and target environment.
